associations.rationale: The equality directly states the character value of each displayed representation on every displayed conjugacy-class representative.
The class-count equality supports completeness of a five-member irreducible family, but does not itself state that the displayed representations are complete.
The formal type only supplies a family of five representations and does not state simplicity, pairwise nonisomorphism, character values, or completeness.
The formal type directly states that representations at distinct indices in the displayed family are nonisomorphic.
The formal type directly states that every representation in the displayed five-member family is simple.
